steps.description: Execute a controlled pivot on the spot to face the Right side, maintaining the Araimandi posture and Alapadma mudra.
steps.teaching_note: Keep the center of gravity low and stable; avoid rising up out of Araimandi during the turn.

steps.description: Take two steps forward (R-L) in the new right-facing direction, keeping the Alapadma mudras held out to the sides.
steps.teaching_note: Focus on clean foot placement, ensuring the knees are still turned out as the step is taken.
